data.name: Manvrita
data.gender_notes: Manvrita is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one whose mind's desire is fulfilled by the divine. In Hindu mythology, Manvrita is the name of a celestial nymph who was blessed by Lord Shiva to have her desires granted. The name Manvrita carries the meaning “Mind's desire” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manvrita usually hope their child will grow to embody mind's desire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Manvrita belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mind's desire.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manvrita total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
